title: Last Bell, 2001
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Two years out: Wood on the far sidewalk at 3:05 with the dog, the bell, the kids, and Gully's flatbed passing with a honk. Gully has the last word through the window; Wood has the one after it.

panels.composition: The school from across the road, 3:05, the bell shape at the door. WOOD on the far sidewalk with BARNABY on a leash.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog on a sidewalk across from a small-town high school with a jagged sound shape at its door, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The doors open; students pour toward the beach road.

image.prompt: students pouring out of a school's front doors toward a beach road, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: A flatbed truck passing between the school and the sidewalk, GULLY's arm out the window, the honk as a small shape.

image.prompt: a flatbed truck passing with a young man's arm out the window and a honk drawn as a small shape, another young man on the sidewalk beyond, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: WOOD watching the truck go, the dog looking up at him.

image.prompt: a young man watching a truck drive away with a small dog looking up at him, brush-pen black and white

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)
